confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderately confident. Lodging is less certain because Vientiane hotel data is sparse, and July is the wet season, when demand is usually softer. cocktail and wine_glass were set from the beer relationship (about 3.6x and 4.1x beer) because direct local knowledge is weak. Kip volatility and post-2022 price growth add uncertainty. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages for 15 October 2026, not a direct read of the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Southeast Asian capitals and tourist cities with similar price levels, such as Luang Prabang and Phnom Penh, with Vientiane's restaurant and hotel prices placed below Bangkok.
